name: Africa
fact: Africa is home to the Sahara, the largest hot desert in the world.

name: Antarctica
fact: Antarctica is so cold that almost no people live there — but lots of penguins do!

name: Asia
fact: Asia is the biggest continent, and more than half of all the people in the world live there.

name: Australia
fact: Australia is the only continent that is also just one country.

name: Europe
fact: Europe has more than 40 different countries packed into one continent.

name: North America
fact: North America stretches all the way from icy Canada down to sunny Mexico.

name: South America
fact: South America is home to the Amazon rainforest, the largest rainforest on Earth.
